label: Sleep and safety rounds
goal: Promote restful sleep while maintaining safety.
caregiver: Complete approved safety check; assist only when awake/needed; record exceptions.
nurse: Review repeated waking, unsafe behavior, pain or change from baseline.

label: Repositioning / comfort, if ordered
caregiver: Reposition/off-load using approved technique and assistance level; inspect exposed risk areas.
nurse: Review pain, redness, skin deterioration or inability to follow plan.

label: Toileting and early-morning support
goal: Maintain continence, dignity and safe mobility.
caregiver: Offer/assist toileting according to schedule; use approved transfer method.
nurse: Review new incontinence, urinary symptoms, constipation, falls or increased assistance.

label: Wake-up, orientation, hygiene and dressing
goal: Follow preferred morning routine and maximize participation.
caregiver: Provide approved setup/cueing/hands-on help; use effective communication approach; observe skin, pain and function.
nurse: Review functional/cognitive change, distress, skin concern or increased assistance.

label: Breakfast, hydration and morning medication
goal: Support safe intake and medication adherence.
caregiver: Provide approved meal assistance; observe intake/swallowing; medication support only within authorized scope/MAR.
nurse: Verify orders/parameters; review poor intake, swallowing concern, omission, refusal or adverse effect.
baselineTasks: Assist resident to the dining area
Set up meal tray and utensils
Encourage and assist with eating and drinking

label: Clinical monitoring, if ordered
caregiver: Obtain ordered readings using approved technique and report exceptions.
nurse: Interpret results/trends and act according to resident-specific parameters and orders.

label: Mobility / therapy carryover / meaningful activity
goal: Maintain safe function and meaningful participation.
caregiver: Provide approved mobility assistance and therapy carryover; follow fall precautions and rest needs.
nurse: Review tolerance, pain, dizziness, fall/near-fall or functional decline; coordinate therapy.
baselineTasks: Offer the scheduled activity or light exercise

label: Toileting, lunch and hydration
goal: Maintain comfort, continence and adequate intake.
caregiver: Assist toileting and meal using approved level, positioning, pacing and texture.
nurse: Review poor intake, dehydration, swallowing signs or elimination change.
baselineTasks: Assist resident to the dining area
Set up meal tray and utensils
Encourage and assist with eating and drinking

label: Rest and handover preparation
caregiver: Support preferred rest; resolve/document incomplete tasks and exceptions.
nurse: Review escalations and prepare pending/owner/due handover.

label: Shift acceptance and resident check
caregiver: Incoming caregiver accepts assigned residents and reviews pending/critical tasks.
nurse: Incoming nurse accepts escalations, priorities and time-critical follow-up.

label: Activity, mobility, hydration and toileting
goal: Maintain function, comfort and psychosocial well-being.
caregiver: Offer individualized activity; assist mobility/toileting; use approved calming and communication approaches.
nurse: Review behavior pattern, falls risk, functional tolerance and clinical causes of change.
baselineTasks: Offer the scheduled activity or light exercise

label: Dinner, hydration and evening medication
goal: Support safe intake and medication adherence.
caregiver: Provide approved meal assistance and medication support within scope/MAR.
nurse: Review omissions, refusal, poor intake, swallowing signs or adverse effects.
baselineTasks: Assist resident to the dining area
Set up meal tray and utensils
Encourage and assist with eating and drinking

label: Calm evening routine
goal: Reduce distress and support preferred evening routine.
caregiver: Use familiar low-stimulation activity, reassurance and effective cueing; address comfort/toileting.
nurse: Review new or severe agitation, altered cognition, pain or possible illness/delirium.

label: Bedtime care and safety setup
goal: Maintain dignity, comfort, skin integrity and safe sleep.
caregiver: Provide hygiene/toileting, skin observation and approved positioning; set least-restrictive safeguards.
nurse: Review skin findings, increased assistance, night risks and unresolved exceptions.

label: Shift acceptance and night assessment
goal: Maintain continuity and safe overnight care.
caregiver: Accept handover; check resident comfort and complete due tasks.
nurse: Prioritize new-since-shift events and pending escalations; confirm night plan.

label: Overnight medication/treatment, if ordered
caregiver: Perform only authorized ordered task; document result and exception.
nurse: Review result, omission/hold, adverse response and escalation.
